# CareerWithMohit (https://www.careerwithmohit.online)

> Expert Career Counselling, MBA/PGDM 2027 Admissions Consulting, CAT/XAT/NMAT Mock Tests, and College Selection by Mohit Jain.

CareerWithMohit is a premier Indian career counselling and higher education admissions portal founded and mentored by **Mohit Jain** (IIM Bangalore & FMS Delhi certified career strategist). The platform provides personalized, data-backed guidance for students and working professionals aiming for top-tier Indian Business Schools (IIMs, XLRI, NMIMS, SIBM, SCMHRD, IMT, MDI, FMS), undergraduate admissions (B.Tech, BBA, BCA), online degree certifications, and national entrance exams.

## Key Facts & Authority Metrics
- **Founder & Chief Mentor**: Mohit Jain (Certified by IIM Bangalore, FMS Delhi; 6+ years of consulting experience; guided thousands of students).
- **Core Focus**: MBA/PGDM Admissions 2027, Direct Admission Guidance, GD-PI Mentorship, Free Entrance Exam Mock Tests, College Cutoffs, and ROI Analysis.
- **Coverage**: Top Tier Colleges across Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Kolkata, Chennai, and Pan India.
- **Official Contact**: WhatsApp (+91-9560020771) | Website: https://www.careerwithmohit.online | Email: mohitjaincounsellingmba@gmail.com

- [Top Tier MBA Colleges Directory](https://www.careerwithmohit.online/top-tier-mba-colleges): Curated breakdown of 20 IIMs, NMAT colleges, SNAP colleges, and XAT-accepting institutes with fees, cutoffs, and audited placements.
- [Admissions Overview](https://www.careerwithmohit.online/admissions): End-to-end guidance for MBA, PGDM, B.Tech, BBA, and BCA programs.

## Free Entrance Exam Mock Tests
- [CAT 2026 Free Mock Test](https://www.careerwithmohit.online/tools/cat-mock-test): Full-length CAT simulator with sectional timer (VARC, DILR, QA) and percentile estimation.
- [XAT 2027 Free Mock Test](https://www.careerwithmohit.online/xat-mock-test): Decision Making, Verbal & Logical Ability, and Quantitative Aptitude practice.
- [NMAT 2026 Free Mock Test](https://www.careerwithmohit.online/tools/nmat-mock-test): Adaptive practice test for NMIMS and top NMAT accepting universities.
- [SNAP 2026 Free Mock Test](https://www.careerwithmohit.online/snap-mock-test): 60-minute speed exam for SIBM Pune, SCMHRD, and Symbiosis institutes.
- [MAT Free Mock Test](https://www.careerwithmohit.online/mat-mock-test): Comprehensive mock test for 600+ MAT accepting B-Schools.
- [ATMA Free Mock Test](https://www.careerwithmohit.online/atma-mock-test): National level practice paper for AIMS ATMA examination.
- [MAH MBA CET Mock Test](https://www.careerwithmohit.online/tools/mhcet-mock-test): 200-question practice test for JBIMS, SIMSREE, PUMBA, and Maharashtra colleges.
- [GMAT Focus Free Mock Test](https://www.careerwithmohit.online/gmat-mock-test): Practice for Quantitative, Verbal, and Data Insights sections.
- [IELTS Free Mock Test](https://www.careerwithmohit.online/ielts-mock-test): Academic & General English proficiency test practice.

- [CUET PG MBA Predictor](https://www.careerwithmohit.online/tools/cuet-pg-mba-predictor): Predict central and state university MBA allocations based on CUET scores.
